paragraphs: A fork of PaddleOCR adapted for Tamil and Dravidian script recognition using Unicode grapheme cluster (Akshara) tokenization.
English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Français | Русский | Español | العربية

This fork of PaddleOCR adapts the PP-OCRv5 recognition pipeline for Tamil and Dravidian scripts using Akshara (Unicode grapheme cluster) tokenization. The PP-OCRv5 model architecture, CTC decoding, losses, backbone, neck, and head are all unchanged — only the recognition tokenizer is swapped from character-level to grapheme-cluster-level.
features: Transforming messy visuals into structured data for the LLM era.
